page.title: Team
page.subtitle: Share one net worth with your household. Everyone keeps their own data; the data of members who share it appears in the team workspace, read-only.

proRequired.title: Teams are part of Pro
proRequired.description: Upgrade to create a team and invite members. Joining a team through an invite link works on every plan.

create.title: Create a team
create.description: You become its owner. Nobody's data is shared until they turn sharing on.
create.name: Team name

empty: You are not in a team yet.

sharing.title: Share my data with this team
sharing.description: Members see your net worth, positions and history in the team workspace, read-only. You can turn this off at any time.

invite.title: Invite members
invite.description: Email invites are not available yet. Create a link and send it yourself. It works once and for 7 days.
invite.linkDescription: Copy this link now: it is shown only once.

confirm.removeDescription: They lose access to the team workspace. Their own data is not affected.
confirm.leaveDescription: You lose access to the team workspace. Your own data is not affected.
confirm.deleteDescription: All members lose access and open invites stop working. Nobody's own data is deleted.
confirm.ownerDescription: You become an admin. Only the new owner can change roles or delete the team.

join.title: Join a team
join.invalid: This invite link is invalid, expired or already used. Ask for a new one.
join.prompt: You were invited to join {team} as {role}.
join.alreadyMember: You are already a member of {team}.
join.joined: You joined {team}. Turn on sharing in Settings > Team when you are ready.

workspace.label: Workspace
workspace.readOnlyBanner: You are viewing {team}: the combined data of {count, plural, one {# sharing member} other {# sharing members}}, read-only. Switch to Personal to make changes.
